sar.narrative: This report concerns customer C02851, card C02851-K2, issued as a visa credit. On 2016-11-01, 1 transaction(s) totalling $8.73 were identified as part of one fraud episode, beginning with transaction 3419059. The activity took place online, product code(s) C, from device profile(s) Moto G (4) Build/NPJS25.93-14-8.1-4 |  | chrome generic | . The transactions were purchases from one device profile used across several customers' cards. The activity is assessed as card-not-present fraud: Rare device profile Moto G (4) Build/NPJS25.93-14-8.1-4 |  | chrome generic |  (9 cards ever) was used on 8 other cards within 30 days, 6 of them for amounts within 2% of this $8.73 purchase (in the closed months this shape was 10.7 times more common in confirmed fraud than in normal online traffic); Device profile Moto G (4) Build/NPJS25.93-14-8.1-4 |  | chrome generic |  appears in 1 confirmed-fraud closed case(s) (CC-5333). The same device profile Moto G (4) Build/NPJS25.93-14-8.1-4 |  | chrome generic |  links this activity to 8 other card(s), including C03260-K1, C05381-K2, C06247-K1, C08962-K2, which indicates a common actor across cardholders. Earlier confirmed cases CC-5333, CC-2454, CC-2826 show the same pattern. The cardholder has not yet been contacted. The bank has recommended BLOCK_CARD, MONITOR_CONNECTED_CARDS and opened an internal case; the report is filed under R6, §3a.
